BOZ64 PC: keyboard and mouse
============================

Menus
  The mouse works like a finger: click to tap, drag to slide. Esc goes back.

Zombies (laid out like Black Ops on PC)
  W A S D or arrow keys   move
  Mouse                   look
  Left button             fire
  Right button            aim down the sights (hold)
  Shift                   sprint (hold)
  C                       crouch
  Ctrl                    go prone
  C or Ctrl while sprinting   dolphin dive (as in Black Ops: you dive forward and land prone)
  Space                   stand up
  R                       reload
  F                       use or buy (doors, wall weapons, perks, the mystery box)
  V, E, middle button or the back side button   knife
  G                       lethal grenade (hold to cook, let go to throw)
  Q or 4                  tactical grenade (hold, let go to throw)
  1, 2, mouse wheel or the front side button    switch weapon (the game only has "next weapon")
  3 or B                  the weapon's other fire mode (for example its grenade launcher)
  Esc                     pause menu

  During play the mouse is locked, as in other PC shooters: the cursor is hidden and held in the middle of the
  window, even through a stutter. It comes back right away in the pause menu (Esc), and when you switch to another
  window (Alt+Tab). Clicking back into the game window doesn't fire.

Dead Ops Arcade (as in the game's PC version)
  W A S D                 move
  Arrow keys              shoot in that direction
  Left button (hold)      shoot toward the cursor (measured from the middle of the screen)
  G, right button or mouse wheel   drop a bomb
  Space                   speed boost
  Esc                     pause menu

Mouse speed
  Set in boz64.cfg, in data\data\data\com.activision.boz\files next to boz64.exe (the game makes the file the first
  time a setting is changed; you can add the lines yourself):
    mouse_sensitivity=5   look speed, the same scale as Call of Duty on PC (default 5)
    mouse_ads=60          look speed while aiming down the sights, in percent of the above (default 60)
  The game picks up changes within a second, even during play. The game's own "invert look" option also applies to
  the mouse.
